channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about San Diego | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about San Diego from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jesse Buss on San Diego
item.description:
Joey Buss said in a statement.

“Sports have always been a part of our family's story, and great organizations have a unique ability to bring people together and create a lasting sense of community. Padres fans have built one of the most passionate and loyal communities in all of sports, and we believe there is a tremendous opportunity to deepen that connection in San Diego and around the world.”

Jesse Buss on San Diego, Aug 26, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Joey Buss on San Diego
item.description:
“We are honored to join Kwanza and José and have the opportunity to contribute to the future of a team that Jesse and I have loved since we were kids growing up in San Diego,”

Joey Buss on San Diego, Aug 26, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on San Diego
item.description:
“San Diego has become a city close to my heart, and I’m proud to invest in a club that is pushing boundaries, building something lasting, and setting a new standard for what women’s sports can be both on and off the pitch.”

Jimmy Butler on San Diego, Oct 20, 2025. Source: San Diego Union-Tribune.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Kawhi Leonard, San Diego
item.description:
“[Kawhi Leonard] is pretty mellow… He likes to fish and loves the ocean. When he won the championship in 2014, we went out in San Diego together and he was getting everything free.”

Klay Thompson on Kawhi Leonard, San Diego, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.
